name: Putting It All Together (Checkpoint)
instructions: Revisit Day 1's posture and hand position -- most beginners naturally improve this without noticing over a few weeks.
Play through one full song from memory if you can, even slowly, as a genuine progress check.
Set your next goal now: a new song, a new scale, or two-hand coordination, so momentum carries past this program.
Revisit today's getting-started video as a checkpoint before the final days.
